🚨 Your Website Is Running. But Is It Really Secure?

Imagine your business website working perfectly.

Customers are browsing. Transactions are happening. Everything looks normal.

But behind the scenes, an outdated PHP version could be exposing your website to serious security risks.

Recent PHP security warnings highlight how vulnerabilities in affected systems can potentially allow attackers to compromise applications and sensitive information.

The real concern?

Many businesses don't discover these weaknesses until something goes wrong.

🔐 That's where Zerix Securities comes in.

We help organizations strengthen their security through:

🔹 Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) – Identify weaknesses before attackers exploit them.

🔹 Security Risk Assessment – Understand which vulnerabilities pose the greatest business risk.

🔹 Remediation Guidance – Prioritize necessary security fixes and validate improvements.

Because cybersecurity isn't just about responding to attacks.

It's about identifying risks before they become incidents.
